topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and annual acknowledgment of POL-05 with the IRC 7216 confidentiality agreement; sanctions applied in 2026
Audit committee receives quarterly cyber reporting; board receives the Qualified Individual's annual written report
gap: Quarterly reporting began 2026; the 2025 board report omitted service providers and test results
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period; complete 2026-10-27 board report (POAM-023)

control_description: Qualified Individual designated in writing; CAS Practice Leader owns the service; roles and risk acceptance authority set in POL-01
Background checks before access; annual training; security staff certifications
gap: No role-based security training for CAS payroll and bill-pay staff
remediation: Role-based CAS training on payment fraud and call-back verification (POAM-005)

control_description: Policy owners named; sanctions procedure; control owners in P02
SIEM collects identity, email, endpoint, firewall, and cloud events
gap: CAS service activity (payroll, accounting, bill pay) is not collected
remediation: Onboard CAS service logs to the SIEM (POAM-006)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies on the intranet; annual training
gap: The 2026 incident response plan has not been distributed to the CAS team; 4 of 15 staff did not know the reporting channel
remediation: Distribute POL-03 and runbooks; reporting channel in training (POAM-014)

control_description: CAS agreements set service scope and fees
gap: Agreements state a 72-hour incident notice but no security commitments; no system description for clients
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; update the agreement template

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for the CAS service (timely, accurate payroll and payments; confidentiality) documented in the BIA and P01
Annual risk assessment includes CAS risks (R-013, R-018, R-019, R-020, R-051)
Fraud risks identified: payee and employee bank-change fraud, payroll manipulation, insider misuse
Infrastructure changes reviewed; acquisitions handled by integration checklist
gap: SaaS feature changes and acquisitions are not assessed for impact on controls
remediation: SaaS change control (POAM-009); security due diligence for acquisitions (P01 R-046)

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); monthly MSSP metrics
POA&M with owners and dates, reviewed monthly and reported quarterly to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk assessment and documented in the SSP
gap: Measurable standards (configuration, logging, vendor) still in draft
remediation: Issue the P06 standards

control_description: Technology general controls for identity, endpoints, and backups
gap: No baselines for the CAS SaaS tenants; local accounts outside SSO
remediation: SaaS baselines in STD-01; CAS federation (POAM-001)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-22
gap: CAS procedures (payroll changes, bill-pay release, client onboarding) not written to the policy level
remediation: Write CAS procedures under POL-02 4.11 and POL-05 4.4

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA for the accounting service; encryption at rest; network segmentation in the cloud
gap: Payroll and bill-pay services use local accounts with SMS codes
remediation: Federate both services with security keys (POAM-001, POAM-012)

control_description: New CAS users approved by the CAS Practice Leader
gap: 3 former CAS staff accounts were active in the payroll and bill-pay services; no HR feed to local accounts
remediation: Federation; monthly reconciliation until then (POAM-001)

control_description: Roles in the CAS services by team
gap: A single CAS approver can change a payee bank account and release payment; annual reviews; standing admin rights in the directory
remediation: Second approver and call-back for bank changes (POAM-024); quarterly reviews; privileged access management (POAM-002)

control_description: Badge access to Office 1, where the CAS team sits; visitor logs
Shredding vendor certificates; drive wiping
gap: Records past retention not disposed of; no CAS data return or deletion step at client offboarding
remediation: Disposal run (POAM-020); offboarding checklist for CAS clients

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Email security gateway; conditional access; CAS client approvers use MFA in the bill-pay service
gap: Token-theft phishing not mitigated for CAS staff; mail reachable from unmanaged devices
remediation: Security keys and device compliance (POAM-012, POAM-003)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all CAS services and the portal
gap: Payroll registers sometimes emailed to clients as plain attachments
remediation: Portal-only delivery and a data loss prevention rule (POAM-019)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints with 24x7 MSSP; software installation restricted

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly scans; monthly for internet-facing services; annual penetration test
gap: 6 of 40 critical findings fixed late; CAS tenants outside the 2025 test scope
remediation: Expanded test scope and patch targets (POAM-008)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors identity, endpoint, and email alerts
gap: No monitoring of CAS service activity (bank changes, payment releases, exports)
remediation: CAS logs to the SIEM with bank-change and export alerts (POAM-006, POAM-007)

control_description: MSSP triage and escalation within 30 minutes
gap: No CAS-specific triage criteria (diverted payment, payroll change)
remediation: Add CAS scenarios to the triage guide

control_description: POL-03 and two runbooks approved 2026-09-22, including CAS payment holds and notice to CAS clients
gap: Not yet exercised
remediation: BEC tabletop 2026-11-19 with a CAS payment-diversion inject (POAM-014)

control_description: Vendor platforms recover the CAS services; backups of Company workloads
gap: The CAS repeat-payroll fallback has never been exercised
remediation: CAS fallback exercise with the payroll vendor (POAM-011)

control_description: Infrastructure change board
gap: CAS service configuration changes (approval rules, user roles) bypass change control
remediation: SaaS change control (POAM-009)

control_description: BIA for BP-10 and BP-11; cyber insurance
gap: No written CAS continuity plan
remediation: CAS section in STD-07

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Security review at onboarding since 2025
gap: Payroll and bill-pay vendors never reviewed after onboarding; subservice organization controls not mapped
remediation: Annual Tier 1 reviews (`vendor-soc2-review.csv`; POAM-017)

control_description: Capacity managed by the SaaS vendors; vendor reports reviewed for capacity commitments
Vendors back up the CAS services; Company backups for its own workloads
gap: Payroll vendor's backup and recovery controls only reviewed through its SOC 1 report, not mapped to the BIA
remediation: Map vendor availability commitments to BP-10 and BP-11 RTOs

control_description: Recovery tested for the DMS only
gap: No recovery test for the CAS service
remediation: CAS fallback exercise (POAM-011)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classifies client ledgers and payroll data as Restricted or Confidential
gap: CAS data still stored in email and personal folders by some staff
remediation: Move CAS working files to the DMS client folders; data loss prevention rule

control_description: Shredding and drive wiping
gap: No deletion or return of CAS client data when a client leaves; retention not executed
remediation: CAS offboarding checklist; disposal run (POAM-020)

control_description: Service scope in CAS agreements
gap: Processing specifications (pay schedules, cutoffs, approval rules) not documented per client
remediation: Client service specification sheet for each CAS client

control_description: Payroll changes received through the portal or email; reviewer checks
gap: Changes accepted by email without call-back; bank changes not verified
remediation: Portal-only change requests; call-back for bank changes (POAM-024)

control_description: Payroll preview reviewed before submission
gap: Second-person review documented for 15 of 25 sampled payrolls
remediation: Required second review for every payroll

control_description: Payroll reports and bill-pay confirmations delivered to clients through the portal; clients approve bill batches
Monthly bank reconciliations of client ledgers; vendors retain payroll history
